qualification.details: General Manager (Signalling & Telecom): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized University/Institute. Chief Engineer (Signalling & Telecom): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering from AICTE/UGC recognized University/Institute or Retd. IRSSE Officers. Executive (HR) (E1) / Asst. Executive (HR) (E0): Full time regular MBA or equivalent with minimum 60% marks with HR as specialization from recognized university/institute. Manager (Finance) (E3): CA/CMA(ICWAI) or MBA (Full time Regular) with Finance as specialization and minimum 60% marks from recognized University/Institute.

salary_details.details: General Manager (Signalling & Telecom): Rs.120000-280000 (IDA) Chief Engineer (Signalling & Telecom): Rs.170000 per month (consolidated) Executive (HR) (E1) / Asst. Executive (HR) (E0): E0: Rs.30000-120000 or E1: Rs.40000-140000 (IDA) Manager (Finance) (E3): Rs.60000-180000 (IDA)

selection_process: Written Test/ Computer Based Test Interview
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of KMRL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Kochi Metro Rail Limited (KMRL) recruitment is 27th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in KMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Kochi Metro Rail Limited (KMRL) has announced a total of 5 vacancies for various posts including General Manager, Chief Engineer, Executive (HR), and Manager (Finance).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Executive (HR) post?
faq.answer: For the Executive (HR) post, candidates must possess a full-time regular MBA or equivalent degree with at least 60% marks, specializing in HR from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for KMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the KMRL Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the KMRL Recruitment 2026 will involve a Written Test/Computer Based Test followed by an Interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Manager (Finance) post?
faq.answer: The Manager (Finance) post (E3) in KMRL Recruitment 2026 offers a salary in the IDA Scale of Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,80,000.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification specifies that applications are invited from eligible candidates in Kerala. It is advisable to check the official notification for detailed eligibility regarding domicile.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The official notification states that age relaxation will be provided as per reservation rules. Specific age limits for each post are not detailed but will be applied as per government norms.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for KMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All eligible candidates must apply online for the KMRL Recruitment 2026. The application process is entirely online, and no other mode of application will be accepted.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the KMRL Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section provided in this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
